reply_text:
I replied to Hollis's message in a thread in #central-team: "Thanks, Hollis. Noted for everyone here: expense reports are due this Friday, 16 Oct."

The message was a reminder, not a request, so I didn't do anything else. I couldn't find anything about the expense deadline in GBrain, so the date comes from Hollis's message. 16 Oct is the Friday of that week, since the message was sent on Wednesday, 14 Oct.
